scope: Encoding methods are selected from the generated concept; any revised contract is versioned before new confirmation seeds are inspected.

area.measurement: Segment complete solid planar island interior including internal texture; exclude cast shadow, external vegetation and label. Calibrate pixels per hectare from the generated 10 hectare square interior; infer every island value with same area scale.
area.unjudgeable: occluded/transparent/ambiguous boundary or missing calibration; never pass

time.measurement: Read generated hour-ruler tick centers, fit one affine x-to-hour calibration to all seven ticks, measure event-node centers; y/path length carries no time. All ticks must be present, ordered and uniformly spaced with residual <= 0.12 hour.
time.unjudgeable: no unambiguous node centers or ruler; never pass

flow.measurement: At preregistered straight transects after split and before labels, segment actual stream thickness normal to centerline. Calibrate with generated 10-unit gauge; check sum of three branch widths against upstream width.
flow.unjudgeable: crossings, perspective, ambiguous boundary or no straight measurement transects; never pass

concept_retention: core silhouette, composition and reading device retained
core plus detailed design grammar retained
design_rubric.joint_pass: all data checks and encoding tolerance pass AND all design dimensions >=2; no traditional bar-chart material substitution

review: Primary agent visual review, nonblind to overall project; shuffle anonymous review sheets when feasible. Not independent user aesthetic judgment.

confirmation.claim_limit: local threshold only, not proof population success rate >=90%
confirmation.holdout: apply same frozen design to second dataset; recompute geometry, do not select a new concept
